svg.text: The load balancer forwards to any healthy node. Here it picked Node 1.

svg.text: Node 1 has no NGINX pod: kube-proxy forwards over the pod network to the one on Node 3.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Virgil, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', cursive
Excalifont, Virgil, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', cursive

svg.text: NGINX matches /api/rag, looks up Service rag-svc, sends to its ready pod on Node 2.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Virgil, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', cursive
Excalifont, Virgil, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', cursive

svg.text: The RAG pod answers, and the response travels back along the same path.
